shortDefinition: A French AI company producing efficient, high-quality open-weights language models.
fullDefinition: Mistral AI is a French AI startup known for releasing efficient, high-quality open-weights language models. The Mistral 7B model gained attention for outperforming much larger models at its size. Mixtral (a mixture-of-experts variant) is popular for local deployment. Mistral models are widely used in the open-source AI ecosystem and via their commercial API (La Plateforme). Le Chat is their consumer-facing chatbot.
